steps.title: The first time, you click
steps.note: A fresh thread has no window, so its first mandate waits for your approval and starts nothing until you give it.

steps.title: You open a window
steps.note: Between 5 minutes and 14 days, with a ceiling on how many teams may start on their own. Bounded on purpose: a window is a loan, not a right.

steps.title: It runs without you
steps.note: Inside the window it starts teams, schedules its own reminders and compacts its own context. You watch, you correct course, you do not gate.

steps.title: The clock or the ceiling closes it
steps.note: Past either one it asks again. Taking the hand back with a manual approval reopens the count from that moment.
